meta.source: UN DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024
meta.revisionPolicy: Each WPP revision re-estimates the whole history from 1950 and re-projects to 2100. A new revision is a new instrument; the raw dump keeps the old one.
meta.coverage: UN WPP 2024 medium-variant projection for India, 2024 to 2100
meta.note: A projection, not data: the UN's medium variant, the median of its probabilistic projections of fertility and mortality, with its assumption for migration. Draw it as a projection.
